answers.core: This is a part of GDScript 2.0 design.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around by prefixing signal names, i.e. `signal_hit` instead of `hit`, or alternatively - changing a method name. But this will ma the addon's api less readable and messy just because limitations of a gdscript 2.0.

title: Signals can't be named same as properties / methods
